input:
I think Benn being aggressive and throwing in tight the way he was was the right call.
But being that heavy on his front foot leaning forward at centre ring was a recipe for disaster, I don’t think that was well thought out lol

Realistically that was Benn’s only real chance to win with fighting like that. He was never going to win a technical boxing match cos he simply doesn’t have that style let alone at this level.
The Benn you seen tonight is him and nothing really changes. It’s been pretty much accepted for a long time that he just isn’t world level and in reality he hasn’t even won a title at British level.
I thought Garcia would win a decision but I never saw him doing what he did. Eubank couldn’t even finish Benn in their first fight when he had him hurt.
I’m not a Benn fan but I do kinda feel bad for him now as he’s been outted for what will be a highlight reel.
Eubank was boiled down to death the fact he even won is laughable
If Benn was really 180+ that night, they sure don't have any plans for the later rounds.
That right hand was so Fkn beautiful. Nobody has faster hands in boxing than Ryan.
In the slow motion you can see him use his left hand to block Benns view of his right and frame it, Benn barely saw it coming, class.
Benn the fat snake got what he deserved. Not a world class fighter, should go back to fighting old bums.

Great fight, awful commentary. Dear God, Garcia was landing at will in the 1st and the commentary just talking about how they aren't 'all' landing and Benn is doing a good job, Gracias going to get tires he's moving too much. 2nd round Garcia stops him, 'i think it was premature, Garcia was robbed of a decisive finish' like my fucking god what are they watching?

The commentary was embarrassing. Kellerman has gone full Stephen A Smith. He literally said “Benn is trying to show Garcia he can take the left hook” nah Max, Garcia is piecing Benn up, he has no choice in this.
Someone finally explained to Benn that there are levels to this.
